title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
title_zh: 随处快思考：用一个 System-1 处理任意智能体工作流中的决策点
abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.
abstract_zh: 自主 LLM 智能体通常在每一步都调用大型模型（System-2），即使许多中间步骤只需从少量已知选项中做出选择，也要付出较高的成本和延迟。现有双系统智能体虽可将这类决策交给轻量级 System-1，却依赖针对各个环境手工编写的工作流钩子。AnyS1 从人编写的流程技能（procedural skills）中提取决策点及其候选选项，使不同领域的工作流能够共享同一个决策模型。离线阶段，AnyS1 从 1,000 多项公开技能中挖掘候选项可枚举的决策，在隔离容器内收集实际执行产生的轨迹状态，构建 Any-DP，并通过标签平滑训练一个经过置信度校准的 4B 指针式 System-1 模型。运行时，编译后的工作流仅需一次前向传播即可处理常规决策，置信度低于校准阈值时则回退至 System-2。在三个未见过的基准和不同的 System-2 模型家族上，相比未编译的 System-2 智能体，AnyS1 在保持任务可靠性的同时，将单次任务执行成本降低 75%–91%，将模型调用耗时缩短 63%–92%；校准阈值直接迁移、无需重新调节时，仍能维持性能。
key_points_zh: 从人编写的流程技能中提取决策点及候选选项，无需为每个环境手工编写决策钩子。
基于 1,000 多项公开技能及隔离容器中的实际执行轨迹构建 Any-DP，训练统一的 4B 指针式 System-1。
常规决策只需一次前向传播；置信度低于校准阈值时回退至 System-2。
在三个未见过的基准上保持任务可靠性，单次任务成本降低 75%–91%，模型调用耗时缩短 63%–92%，且阈值可零样本迁移。

llm_assessment.comment: Compiling procedural skills into decision points, training on execution trajectories, and escalating uncertain decisions offer a reusable way to cut agent costs across workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 将流程技能编译为决策点，用执行轨迹训练轻量模型，并在置信度不足时转交大模型，为不同工作流降低智能体成本提供了可复用的方法。
